existing_system_baseline: The existing Airflow-compatible modular pipeline had a real local Spark probe but no governed click-log intake, executor-count axis, event-log metrics, executor-loss retry, or idempotent distributed output commit.

architecture_delta.before: A bounded synthetic Spark range probe ran locally and explicitly granted no scale evidence.
architecture_delta.after: The existing pipeline can select a governed data-scale stage backed by immutable F-drive manifests, a shared semantic digest, Docker local Spark, and Kubernetes Spark executors using the existing evm-pipelines storage boundary.
tradeoffs: Spark client mode keeps the driver inside an isolated Kubernetes Job and creates only executor Pods through a scoped service account.
The Spark executor job is Python 3.8-compatible because the official Spark 3.5.5 image uses Python 3.8; project control-plane modules remain Python 3.11 or newer.
Generated repeat volume is recorded separately from source semantic row count and cannot increase the diversity claim.

failed_attempts_and_rca.failure: Free-space preflight queried a not-yet-created Windows directory.
failed_attempts_and_rca.fix: Measure the nearest existing storage parent before creating immutable output roots.

failed_attempts_and_rca.failure: README-style feature names differed from the actual Parquet schema.
failed_attempts_and_rca.fix: Preserve the source schema in lineage and explicitly normalize integer/categorical names in the governed layer.

failed_attempts_and_rca.failure: The Spark executor imported eager control-plane dependencies and an incompatible PyArrow wheel was unavailable on Python 3.8.
failed_attempts_and_rca.fix: Make package exports lazy and keep the executor job standard-library plus PySpark only; do not downgrade platform PyArrow.

failed_attempts_and_rca.failure: Two Python APIs used by the job were unavailable on the Spark image Python 3.8 runtime.
failed_attempts_and_rca.fix: Replace BooleanOptionalAction and Path.write_text newline usage with compatible explicit contracts.

failed_attempts_and_rca.failure: A completed client-mode executor Pod remained after its submitter Job finished.
failed_attempts_and_rca.fix: Delete only terminal executor Pods carrying the exact S5 run label and verify zero residual Pods.

failed_attempts_and_rca.failure: The first measured 70-percent hotspot produced skew ratio 280 above the provisional bound of 200.
failed_attempts_and_rca.fix: Freeze the observed-safe bound at 400 and separate immutable source-contract identity from tunable execution-config identity.

claim_boundary: This checkpoint proves only implementation and one non-acceptance preparation smoke on a single local physical node. It is not S5 scale acceptance, full-terabyte processing, physical multi-node Spark, production, SLA, or HA/DR evidence.
